meaning: Recall: fallingtraining/risingvalidation describestrendnotcause; monitorval_loss patience5 minDelta0; finalweightsnotautomaticallybest. Illustrativecurves no actualrunclaim.
prompt: Candid reader-direction restaging. First canonical Demir, second engineeringROOMONLY, final outward-two-papers scene. Remove both held papers entirely. Demir stands naturally leaning slightly over the real engineering console, visible3quarter face with thoughtful concentration, mouth relaxed and brows mildly drawn as he compares the two example trends. His RIGHT hand rests flat on console ledge, five natural digits. His LEFT hand lightly operates a broad physical comparison-selector control beside keyboard, neutral wrist and clearly correct thumb placement. No heldcard, no presentinggesture, no camera gaze. Full torso/shoulder/arms adjust to the console naturally, no necktwist. One working monitor faces Demir, camera on same viewing side. Monitor EXACT compact content: heading 'Example trends'; two simple plots stacked, upper 'Training' with a steadily FALLING smooth trace, lower 'Validation' with a gently RISING smooth trace, both axes labeled 'Loss' vertically and 'Epoch' horizontally, no numericalticks. These are qualitative examples explicitly labeled, not a learner run. A small footer below reads 'Cause unconfirmed'. A separate small setting field reads 'val_loss' and 'Patience: 5'. This is observation before investigating cause, no overfittingdiagnosis, no fakeconvergedsuccess. Every glyph/axis/trace/box maps to actualmonitorquad, never flatpaste. Other monitors dark. Keep scene lively through specific focused work and recognizably same engineering tools/hanginglamps. Full1536x1024, clean cel-shaded illustration. Canonical portraits are identity authority, room master is architecture ONLY, final image is target. Preserve exact canonical face shape/nose/jaw/eyes/age/hair/equipment; Farah lens anatomical LEFT, Demir comms anatomical RIGHT. Moderate warm stylized adult proportions, no shrinking heads. Natural working or relational eyelines, no camera gaze. All shoulders/elbows/wrists/hands continuous; one thumb and four fingers per hand with plausible contact, neutral wrists, no extra arms or mirrored hands. Text/graphs must share supporting screen/paper plane and face the person using them, including foreshortening and baselines. Inactive secondary screens, no arbitrary waves/bars. Muted gray-sage, charcoal/worn brass, natural warm skin; no neon mint or mustard wash.
